module: Invisible spherical trigger: from an invisibleTrigger POI (pos, radius, onEnter, onInside, onExit), calls the Lua callbacks when a player's vehicle enters the sphere, stays in it, or leaves it. The inside/outside state is tracked per player (multiseat) and kept by cluster id. The module returns {create, cluster}. Useful for gameplay triggers without any visual.
notes: The callbacks receive interactData: vehPos, isWalking, playerIndex (0 if absent), etc.
Nothing is triggered when the player is walking (isWalking); the inside/outside state is then not updated.
The insideByCluster state is kept across marker recreations (POI regeneration) so as not to retrigger onEnter for a player already inside; hide() clears this state for the cluster.
Cluster: one per POI, id 'invisibleTrigger#<poi.id>', visibilityRadius = 0, showOnMinimap = false.

create.desc: Builds an invisible trigger marker (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Turns each invisibleTrigger POI into a distinct cluster (no merging) and adds it to allClusters.

pois.desc: POIs with markerInfo.invisibleTrigger {pos, radius, onEnter, onInside, onExit}.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

update.desc: Does nothing (the debug drawing is commented out).

interactWhileMoving.desc: Called every frame: if the player's vehicle is in the sphere, calls onEnter (on the first frame inside) then onInside; when leaving, calls onExit.

setup.desc: Stores cluster, pos, radius and the three callbacks; links the per-player inside/outside state to that of the cluster id.

hide.desc: Clears the inside/outside state of all players for this cluster.
